sta_fsm: Turnaround (drive 10 on write, tri-state on read)
phy_fsm: Decode ST to pick Clause 22 vs 45
If matched: decode OP and REGAD/DEVAD
On read: drive 0 in TA bit 2 then drive 16-bit data MSB first
On write: latch 16-bit data into the addressed register
If not matched: leave MDIO high-impedance
control_logic.addressing: 5-bit PHYAD/PRTAD selects one of 32 PHYs/ports; non-selected PHYs stay high-impedance.
control_logic.turnaround: Bus-direction reversal: STA releases MDIO (Z) in TA bit 1 on a read, PHY drives 0 in TA bit 2, avoiding simultaneous drive.
